name: Crop Diseases, Pests, Weeds & Integrated Farm Ecology Runtime
design_rules: crop threats emerge from host susceptibility and field conditions
disease and pest pressure accumulate over time rather than appearing as arbitrary instant failure
weeds compete for water and fertility and reduce crop performance
crop rotation and intercropping can reduce specific threat pressure
control methods reduce pressure but may have soil tradeoffs
legumes can improve soil fertility and contribute to integrated farm ecology
farm ecology state persists across world days
farm ecology never uses emissive or glow feedback
